**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The MFN rule is a direction rule, and here the direction favours us:

- **Section 1.8 (p0013–p0014)** is the only "no less favorably" covenant in the document, and it binds **HDI**, not the Company: HDI must promote the Site and Deerskin Products no less favorably than its own catalog titles, with HDI bearing promotion costs. That is an MFN-flavoured benefit to us and is expressly not to be redlined.
- **Section 3 (Fees; Payment, p0018–p0022)** is a fixed 30% of Net Sales above an $11,000 monthly threshold — no obligation to extend HDI any better terms given to third parties, no right-to-match, no benchmarking or best-price disclosure mechanic.
- **Section 6 (Exclusivity, p0037–p0042)** restricts the Company from similar Internet projects and gives HDI the exclusive right to the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained site. That is an exclusivity/field-of-use restriction, not an MFN mechanic; it belongs to the exclusivity rule and I have not double-flagged it here.

Because the preferred element ("Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor") is already met on the document's face, no redline was proposed.
